message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Contact | |---------|---------|------------|---------| | **Miami Central Station (Miami Intermodal Center)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | • Pets are welcome in the station building (including the waiting areas, shops, and restrooms).
• On the trains (Amtrak & Tri‑Rail) only small pets in carriers are allowed; larger pets must travel as checked baggage or not at all.
• The station has a dedicated “pet relief” area near the entrance for dogs. | Phone: **305‑284‑4000** (Amtrak/Tri‑Rail customer service) | ### Why it’s pet‑friendly - **Central hub**: It’s the only major train station in Miami, serving Amtrak, Tri‑Rail, and local Metrorail connections. - **Pet‑relief area**: A small fenced space near the main entrance lets dogs stretch and relieve themselves before boarding. - **Accessible amenities**: Restrooms, seating, and a small café are all pet‑friendly, so you can comfortably wait with your dog. - **Clear policy**: The station’s official website and Amtrak/Tri‑Rail guidelines state that pets are allowed in the station but must be in carriers on the train, ensuring a smooth experience for both you and your pet. ### Quick Tips 1. **Check the train’s pet policy** before you travel—most Amtrak and Tri‑Rail services allow small pets in carriers, but larger dogs usually need to be checked in as cargo. 2. **Arrive early** to give your dog time to use the relief area and get comfortable in the station. 3. **Bring a carrier** that meets the train’s size requirements (usually 18 in × 14 in × 12 in for Amtrak). If you need more detailed information or have special requirements (e.g., service animals), call the station’s customer service line at **305‑284‑4000**. Happy travels!
